query:
SELECT e.id, e.fullName, d.id as deviceRowId, d.deviceId, d.deviceName, d.platform, d.status, d.registeredAt
FROM devices d
JOIN employees e ON e.id = d.employeeId
WHERE e.fullName LIKE '%許玉%'
ORDER BY d.registeredAt DESC;
